recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-5605. If FHIR-53787 is later resolved, handle extension deprecation or terminology-service wording as a separate current-core/FHIR-extensions decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5605 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core terminology-service change request asking how a client can discover which code system filter properties a terminology server supports and where the then-current supported-system extension should be placed. The recorded resolution was to use SVN r4364 to clarify usage of the extension.
initial_application: No git commit directly mentions FHIR-5605, but the Jira resolution points to SVN r4364. That revision is git commit da0f89e775d2cf65f97788b4fcfa6a1eab98a752, which changed source/terminology-service.html from a bare supported-system extension fragment into a full Conformance resource example and explicitly stated that the extension is added to the root Conformance Statement. Commit 6106a1be5b1703ee84bdbe31a1b6202faa8a567c later preserved that guidance through the CapabilityStatement rename and canonical URL update.
additional_context: The current terminology-service page is in build scope and still says the capabilitystatement-supported-system extension is added to the root CapabilityStatement. The current active TerminologyCapabilities resource defines TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.version.filter and filter.op for declaring supported filter properties and operators per code-system version. The extension definition itself now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack. FHIR-53787 is a later Submitted/unresolved FHIR-extensions deprecation request, so it is background only and not a final reversal.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The applied r4364 clarification remains present, and the current filter-discovery mechanism is already represented by TerminologyCapabilities rather than by adding redundant terminology-service prose while FHIR-53787 remains unresolved.

related_jiras.note: Submitted/unresolved FHIR-extensions request to deprecate capabilitystatement-supported-system in favor of TerminologyCapabilities; not final and not decided here.
